claims.claim: Atorvastatin reduces the risk of major cardiovascular events (MI, stroke, coronary revascularization) in adults with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
Metformin lowers HbA1c and is effective as first-line glucose-lowering therapy in adults with type 2 diabetes.
Sertraline reduces depressive symptom severity in adults with moderate-to-severe major depressive disorder.
Oseltamivir shortens the duration of influenza symptoms when started within 48 hours of onset in otherwise healthy adults with confirmed influenza.
Omeprazole heals erosive esophagitis and relieves symptoms in adults with gastroesophageal reflux disease.
Levodopa/carbidopa improves motor function and reduces bradykinesia and rigidity in patients with idiopathic Parkinson's disease.
Imatinib induces durable complete cytogenetic and molecular responses in patients with newly diagnosed chronic-phase BCR-ABL-positive chronic myeloid leukemia.
Inhaled fluticasone/salmeterol reduces exacerbation frequency and improves symptom control in adults with moderate-to-severe asthma inadequately controlled on inhaled corticosteroid alone.
Methotrexate slows radiographic joint damage and reduces disease activity in adults with active rheumatoid arthritis.
Amoxicillin cures acute bacterial community-acquired pneumonia caused by susceptible Streptococcus pneumoniae in adults.
Empagliflozin reduces the risk of cardiovascular death and heart failure hospitalization in patients with heart failure, including those with preserved ejection fraction.
Semaglutide produces clinically significant weight loss in adults with obesity without diabetes.
Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir achieves sustained virologic response (cure) across all major genotypes in adults with chronic hepatitis C virus infection.
Azithromycin shortens illness duration and improves outcomes in adults with acute uncomplicated bronchitis (a predominantly viral illness).
Fluoxetine cures acute uncomplicated urinary tract infection in adult women.
Gabapentin provides clinically meaningful relief of chronic low back pain (a non-neuropathic pain condition) in adults.
Oseltamivir reduces influenza-related complications such as hospitalization and pneumonia in otherwise healthy adults.
Digoxin reduces all-cause mortality in patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction in sinus rhythm.
Aspirin reduces the risk of first cardiovascular events (primary prevention) in adults without established cardiovascular disease.
Hydroxychloroquine reduces mortality or accelerates recovery in hospitalized patients with COVID-19.
Warfarin reduces the risk of ischemic stroke in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation.
Vancomycin (oral) achieves clinical cure in adults with Clostridioides difficile infection.
Donepezil produces modest improvement in cognition and global function in patients with mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's disease.
Rivaroxaban treats acute venous thromboembolism (deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism) and prevents recurrence in adults.
